decisive_failure: originality: The headline disproof claim that Pf=f and the H^s quotient is 1 on holomorphic data is the textbook definition of the Bergman projection restated. Every standard source (Barrett 1992 preliminaries, Krantz Function Theory of Several Complex Variables, D'Angelo, Chen-Shaw) defines P as the L2 orthogonal projection onto A2 and states reproduction on A2. A timestamp or failed live search does not establish priority; substantively the submitted headline is immediately implied by that definition without any new argument, computation, or extension. Hence no original contribution. Live retrieval was attempted and reported total outage, but definitional textbook status does not depend on it. value: TARGET route as declared in research_report.claim_route. The admitted target required certifying Sobolev blowup R_j(s)>=C lambda^j for s>=S0. The submission does not complete that criterion; it refutes only the literal holomorphic-witness wording and by its own limitations leaves Barrett-type irregularity with non-holomorphic data, Szego, weighted, L^p and unbounded variants undecided. As an independent finding the exact quotient 1 on holomorphic inputs is a textbook restatement exposing a wording slip (holomorphic vs smooth test functions) rather than a motivated exact invariant of a natural object. It is not independently worth retrieving later. No ADMISSION_DEFECT re-litigation is needed; the target value case for a blowup ledger is simply unmet.
